questions.explanation: 破折号后列举了“早婚、不安全、女性缺乏言论自由”，这些都属于社会对女性的不公平对待，故选injustices（不公正）。demands要求；elements要素；functions功能，均不符合语境。
questions.supplement:
A(demands): 语境句：The workers' demands for higher pay were eventually met by the company. 固定搭配：meet demands, make demands
B(elements): 语境句：Honesty and hard work are the essential elements of success. 固定搭配：essential elements, key elements
C(injustices): 语境句：The documentary exposes the social injustices suffered by minority groups. 固定搭配：suffer injustices, fight against injustices
D(functions): 语境句：The heart has the important function of pumping blood around the body. 固定搭配：bodily functions, perform a function

questions.explanation: 根据后文“establishing future profession（建立未来的职业）”可知，她对未来的“职业（occupation）”感到迷茫。marriage婚姻；security安全；wealth财富，均与后文的profession不呼应。
questions.supplement:
A(marriage): 语境句：They celebrated their 50th year of happy marriage last week. 固定搭配：arranged marriage, early marriage
B(security): 语境句：Job security is a major concern for many young graduates today. 固定搭配：national security, job security
C(wealth): 语境句：He accumulated great wealth through his successful business ventures. 固定搭配：accumulate wealth, create wealth
D(occupation): 语境句：Please state your name, age, and occupation on the application form. 固定搭配：choose an occupation, main occupation

questions.explanation: 句意为这个在线学习项目“包含”许多科目。comprise表“包含、由……组成”，可直接加宾语（A comprises B）；若用compose，需用被动形式be composed of。lack缺乏；limit限制，不符合语意。
questions.supplement:
A(composed): 语境句：The committee is composed of experts from various fields. 固定搭配：be composed of, stay composed
B(comprised): 语境句：The medical team comprised five doctors and ten nurses. 固定搭配：comprise of (非正式), be comprised of
C(lacked): 语境句：He lacked the necessary skills for the job and was rejected. 固定搭配：lack experience, lack confidence
D(limited): 语境句：Our resources are limited, so we must use them wisely. 固定搭配：be limited to, limited time

questions.explanation: 根据后半句“so she ... the opportunity to take part in it”可知，她把“参与（participation）”这个项目视为建立未来职业的关键。evaluation评估；identification识别；competition竞争。
questions.supplement:
A(evaluation): 语境句：The students' performance will be subject to continuous evaluation. 固定搭配：performance evaluation, conduct an evaluation
B(identification): 语境句：Please carry some form of identification with you at all times. 固定搭配：personal identification, identification card
C(competition): 语境句：She faced fierce competition from other candidates for the position. 固定搭配：fierce competition, enter a competition
D(participation): 语境句：Active participation in class discussions is highly encouraged. 固定搭配：active participation, encourage participation

questions.explanation: 因为她视此为建立职业的关键，所以她“迫不及待地接受/抓住（jumped at）”这个机会。turn down拒绝；miss out错过；look for寻找。
questions.supplement:
A(jumped at): 语境句：When offered the chance to study abroad, she jumped at it. 固定搭配：jump at the chance, jump at the opportunity
B(turned down): 语境句：He turned down the job offer because the salary was too low. 固定搭配：turn down an offer, turn down a request
C(missed out): 语境句：If you don't come to the party, you'll miss out on all the fun. 固定搭配：miss out on, not want to miss out
D(looked for): 语境句：He has been looking for his lost keys all morning. 固定搭配：look for a job, look for help

questions.explanation: “make a decision lightly”意为“草率地做决定”。结合后文可知，她的家人不支持，她费了很大力气说服家人，因此这个决定并非“轻易/草率（lightly）”做出的。individually单独地；seriously严肃地；cautiously谨慎地。
questions.supplement:
A(lightly): 语境句：Choosing a university is not a decision to be taken lightly. 固定搭配：take something lightly, tread lightly
B(individually): 语境句：The teacher answered the students' questions individually. 固定搭配：treat individually, wrap individually
C(seriously): 语境句：You need to take your academic studies more seriously. 固定搭配：take seriously, seriously injured
D(cautiously): 语境句：He cautiously approached the stray dog to avoid scaring it. 固定搭配：proceed cautiously, tread cautiously

questions.explanation: 家人不支持她，所以她想尽一切办法去“证明/展示（demonstrate）”自己有多认真。deny否认；admit承认；complain抱怨。
questions.supplement:
A(deny): 语境句：She could not deny the fact that she had made a terrible mistake. 固定搭配：deny doing something, strongly deny
B(admit): 语境句：He finally admitted breaking the window during the game. 固定搭配：admit to doing, freely admit
C(complain): 语境句：Customers began to complain about the poor quality of the service. 固定搭配：complain about, complain of
D(demonstrate): 语境句：The student's excellent project demonstrated his deep understanding of the subject. 固定搭配：demonstrate an ability, demonstrate clearly

questions.explanation: 句中的but表转折，后文是“不去做任何不恰当(inappropriate)的事”，因此前文承诺做的事应当是“恰当的（proper）”，与inappropriate形成反义对应。
questions.supplement:
A(proper): 语境句：It is important to wear proper clothes for a formal interview. 固定搭配：proper behavior, in a proper way
B(expensive): 语境句：Living in the city center can be extremely expensive. 固定搭配：expensive taste, prohibitively expensive
C(complex): 语境句：The scientist proposed a new theory to explain the complex phenomenon. 固定搭配：complex structure, complex issue
D(conventional): 语境句：He prefers conventional medical treatments to alternative therapies. 固定搭配：conventional wisdom, conventional method

questions.explanation: 上文提到她做出了各种努力与承诺，副词Eventually（最终）暗示结果是好的，家人不得不“尊重/接受（respect）”她的决定。reject拒绝；oppose反对；clarify澄清。
questions.supplement:
A(reject): 语境句：The board decided to reject the proposal due to a lack of funds. 固定搭配：reject an offer, firmly reject
B(respect): 语境句：We should respect the diverse cultural backgrounds of our classmates. 固定搭配：respect a decision, show respect for
C(oppose): 语境句：Many local residents strongly oppose the building of the new factory. 固定搭配：oppose a plan, strongly oppose
D(clarify): 语境句：Could you please clarify your main point in the last paragraph? 固定搭配：clarify a situation, seek to clarify

questions.explanation: 后文说她“从不试图向他们隐瞒任何事”，说明她在学习过程中让家人“参与（involved）”其中。protect保护；threaten威胁；cheat欺骗。
questions.supplement:
A(involved): 语境句：The teacher involved all the students in the group discussion. 固定搭配：be involved in, get involved
B(protected): 语境句：The rare birds are strictly protected by local environmental laws. 固定搭配：protect from, highly protected
C(threatened): 语境句：The heavy storm threatened to destroy the coastal village. 固定搭配：feel threatened, threaten to do
D(cheated): 语境句：He was expelled from school because he cheated on the final exam. 固定搭配：cheat on, cheat out of

questions.explanation: 句意：如果家人理解Ruqaia做这件事的“动机（motive）”，他们就更有可能理解她所做事情的优势。profile简介；routine常规；habit习惯。
questions.supplement:
A(profile): 语境句：You need to update your online profile to attract more employers. 固定搭配：keep a low profile, raise someone's profile
B(motive): 语境句：The police are still trying to find out the motive for the crime. 固定搭配：hidden motive, ulterior motive
C(routine): 语境句：Exercising every morning has become part of my daily routine. 固定搭配：daily routine, break the routine
D(habit): 语境句：Reading before bed is a good habit that benefits your mind. 固定搭配：develop a habit, kick a habit

questions.explanation: 她完成了这个项目，并接着去开罗大学“注册/就读（register）”。register in意为“在……注册/入学”。teach教书；consume消耗；invest投资。
questions.supplement:
A(teach): 语境句：She plans to teach English in a remote village after graduation. 固定搭配：teach oneself, teach someone a lesson
B(consume): 语境句：These new LED bulbs consume much less electricity than traditional ones. 固定搭配：consume energy, time-consuming
C(register): 语境句：You must register online before you can attend the conference. 固定搭配：register for, register in
D(invest): 语境句：The government decided to invest heavily in public transportation. 固定搭配：invest in, invest heavily

questions.explanation: 文章主旨及第一段均指出这是关于妇女和女童的教育问题，因此她回馈社会的方式是开设一所专注于“女性（females）”的学校。males男性；seniors长者；adults成年人。
questions.supplement:
A(males): 语境句：In this species of bird, the males are more brightly colored than the females. 固定搭配：adult males, dominant males
B(females): 语境句：The organization aims to empower females in rural and impoverished areas. 固定搭配：adult females, empower females
C(seniors): 语境句：The community center offers free health check-ups for local seniors. 固定搭配：high school seniors, care for seniors
D(adults): 语境句：This movie is suitable for both children and adults. 固定搭配：young adults, grown adults

questions.explanation: 她帮助女性在社区找到“体面的（decent）”工作，这是对社会的回馈。back-breaking繁重折骨的；time-consuming耗时的；shameless无耻的，均含贬义或不符语境。
questions.supplement:
A(back-breaking): 语境句：Farming without modern machinery used to be back-breaking work. 固定搭配：back-breaking labor, back-breaking tasks
B(time-consuming): 语境句：Filling out all these complicated forms is incredibly time-consuming. 固定搭配：time-consuming process, highly time-consuming
C(shameless): 语境句：His shameless behavior at the formal dinner shocked everyone present. 固定搭配：shameless lie, shameless self-promotion
D(decent): 语境句：Everyone deserves a decent place to live and a stable job. 固定搭配：decent job, decent living

questions.explanation: Ruqaia的故事促使当地社区“承认/认识到（acknowledge）”教育对妇女和女童职业规划的重要性。ignore忽视；maintain维持；restore恢复。
questions.supplement:
A(ignore): 语境句：You cannot simply ignore the doctor's advice if you want to recover. 固定搭配：ignore reality, completely ignore
B(maintain): 语境句：It is vital to maintain a balanced diet for good health. 固定搭配：maintain a relationship, maintain order
C(acknowledge): 语境句：The government must acknowledge the severity of the environmental crisis. 固定搭配：acknowledge the importance, acknowledge defeat
D(restore): 语境句：The ancient temple was carefully restored to its original glory. 固定搭配：restore order, restore confidence

vocab_pack.definition_en: a community located in the countryside
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作表语的一部分，a rural community 是名词短语，前面有不定冠词 a，表示泛指一个农村社区。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many children in rural communities lack access to quality education.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多农村社区的儿童缺乏优质教育的机会。
vocab_pack.from_passage: is from a rural community in Egypt

vocab_pack.definition_en: suitable or appropriate for a particular purpose
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作主语补足语，接在 considered 后，fit 为形容词原形，表示‘被认为不适合’。
vocab_pack.example_en: This climate is not fit for growing rice.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这种气候不适合种植水稻。
vocab_pack.from_passage: not considered 'fit' for women and girls

vocab_pack.definition_en: lack of fairness or justice
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作宾语，为可数名词复数形式 injustices，表示多种不公正现象。
vocab_pack.example_en: She fought against social injustice all her life.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她一生都在与社会不公作斗争。
vocab_pack.from_passage: saw many injustices in her society

vocab_pack.definition_en: marriage contracted at a young age, often before adulthood
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中与 unsafety 和 lack of freedom of speech 并列，作 saw 的宾语，为名词短语，无冠词。
vocab_pack.example_en: Early marriage often deprives girls of educational opportunities.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 早婚常常剥夺女孩受教育的机会。
vocab_pack.from_passage: early marriage, unsafety and lack of freedom of speech

vocab_pack.definition_en: the absence or deficiency of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中为固定短语，与 unsafety 等并列，其后接名词 freedom of speech，表示‘缺乏言论自由’。
vocab_pack.example_en: The project failed due to a lack of funding.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该项目因缺乏资金而失败。
vocab_pack.from_passage: lack of freedom of speech for women

vocab_pack.definition_en: the right to express one's opinions without censorship or restraint
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作 lack of 的宾语，为不可数名词短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Freedom of speech is a fundamental human right.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 言论自由是一项基本人权。
vocab_pack.from_passage: lack of freedom of speech for women

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be confused or uncertain about what to do
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中为过去时 was at a loss，后接 as to what to do，表示对未来的职业方向感到迷茫。
vocab_pack.example_en: When asked about the plan, he was at a loss for words.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 当被问及计划时，他不知该说什么。
vocab_pack.from_passage: She was at a loss as to what to do with her future occupation

vocab_pack.definition_en: an educational program delivered online or through digital means
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作主语补足语，与 presented with 搭配，前面有不定冠词 a。
vocab_pack.example_en: The university launched a virtual learning programme for remote students.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该大学为远程学生推出了一项虚拟学习项目。
vocab_pack.from_passage: presented with a virtual learning programme

vocab_pack.definition_en: to consist of; to include
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中为过去时，主语 which（指 programme），comprised 为及物动词，后面直接跟宾语 many subjects。
vocab_pack.example_en: The collection comprises over 200 works of art.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该收藏品包含200多件艺术品。
vocab_pack.from_passage: which comprised many subjects

vocab_pack.definition_en: to consider or regard something in a particular way
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中为过去时，viewed 后接宾语 the participation，as 后接名词短语 a key，表示‘视参与为关键’。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many people view education as a pathway to success.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多人视教育为成功之路。
vocab_pack.from_passage: viewed the participation in the programme as a key

vocab_pack.definition_en: something that provides access to or a means of achieving something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作 as 的宾语，a key to 后接动名词 establishing，表示‘建立未来职业的关键’。
vocab_pack.example_en: Practice is the key to mastering any skill.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 练习是掌握任何技能的关键。
vocab_pack.from_passage: viewed the participation in the programme as a key to establishing future profession

vocab_pack.definition_en: to set up or create something on a firm basis
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中为动名词形式，作介词 to 的宾语，与 establishing future profession 构成介词短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: They plan to establish a new company next year.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他们计划明年成立一家新公司。
vocab_pack.from_passage: establishing future profession

vocab_pack.definition_en: to accept an opportunity or offer eagerly
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中为过去时 jumped at，后接名词短语 the opportunity，表示‘急切抓住这个机会’。
vocab_pack.example_en: She jumped at the chance to study abroad.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她急切地抓住了出国学习的机会。
vocab_pack.from_passage: she jumped at the opportunity to take part in it

vocab_pack.definition_en: to participate in something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中为不定式短语，修饰 opportunity，take 为动词原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: All students are encouraged to take part in the competition.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 鼓励所有学生参加比赛。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the opportunity to take part in it

vocab_pack.definition_en: without careful thought; carelessly
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中修饰过去分词 made，lightly 放在 made 之后，表示决定不是轻易做出的。
vocab_pack.example_en: He took the criticism lightly, which annoyed his boss.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他对批评满不在乎，这让老板很恼火。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the decision was not made lightly

vocab_pack.definition_en: to follow or chase something with the aim of achieving it
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中为动词原形，用于不定式 to pursue her education，表示‘追求教育’。
vocab_pack.example_en: She decided to pursue a career in medicine.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她决定从事医学事业。
vocab_pack.from_passage: her decision to pursue her education

vocab_pack.definition_en: to try very hard to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中为过去时，made every effort 后接不定式 to demonstrate，表示‘尽一切努力来证明’。
vocab_pack.example_en: We must make every effort to protect the environment.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们必须尽一切努力保护环境。
vocab_pack.from_passage: made every effort to demonstrate how serious she was

vocab_pack.definition_en: to show clearly; to prove
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中为动词原形，用于不定式 to demonstrate，后接 how serious she was 从句。
vocab_pack.example_en: This experiment demonstrates the importance of safety measures.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这个实验证明了安全措施的重要性。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to demonstrate how serious she was

vocab_pack.definition_en: to persuade someone to behave reasonably
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中为动名词短语，作 tried 的宾语，talking sense into 后接宾语 them。
vocab_pack.example_en: I tried to talk sense into him, but he wouldn't listen.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我试图说服他理智点，但他不听。
vocab_pack.from_passage: tried talking sense into them by promising...

vocab_pack.definition_en: suitable or appropriate in behavior or circumstances
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作定语修饰 everything，that is proper for family traditions 为定语从句，proper 是表语。
vocab_pack.example_en: It is not proper to interrupt someone while they are speaking.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 打断别人说话是不合适的。
vocab_pack.from_passage: everything that is proper for family traditions

vocab_pack.definition_en: not suitable or proper in the circumstances
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作表语，用于定语从句 that is inappropriate，与前面的 proper 形成对比。
vocab_pack.example_en: Such language is inappropriate in a formal meeting.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这种语言在正式会议上是不恰当的。
vocab_pack.from_passage: anything that is inappropriate

vocab_pack.definition_en: to comply with or follow (a rule, command, or tradition)
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中为过去时，obeyed 后接宾语 her family traditions，表示‘遵守家庭传统’。
vocab_pack.example_en: All citizens must obey the law.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 所有公民都必须遵守法律。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Ruqaia always obeyed her family traditions

vocab_pack.definition_en: to include or engage someone in an activity
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中为过去时，involved 后接间接宾语 her family，直接宾语省略，in 后接名词短语 the process。
vocab_pack.example_en: The teacher involved all students in the group project.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 老师让所有学生都参与了小组项目。
vocab_pack.from_passage: involved her family in the process

vocab_pack.definition_en: to conceal something from someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中为动词原形，用于不定式 to hide，anything 为宾语，from them 为介词短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: You shouldn't hide the truth from your parents.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你不应该对父母隐瞒真相。
vocab_pack.from_passage: never tried to hide anything from them

vocab_pack.definition_en: a reason for doing something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作 understood 的宾语，所有格 Ruqaia's 修饰，为单数形式。
vocab_pack.example_en: What was the motive behind his sudden resignation?
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他突然辞职的动机是什么？
vocab_pack.from_passage: If her family understood Ruqaia's motive

vocab_pack.definition_en: to yield positive results; to succeed after effort
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中为过去时，主语 hard work，paid off 为不及物动词短语，表示‘努力得到了回报’。
vocab_pack.example_en: All the training paid off when she won the gold medal.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 当她赢得金牌时，所有的训练都得到了回报。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Ruqaia's hard work paid off

vocab_pack.definition_en: to officially enroll or record something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中为动词原形，用于不定式 to register in Cairo University，表示‘注册进入开罗大学’。
vocab_pack.example_en: You need to register for the course before the deadline.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 你需要在截止日期前注册这门课程。
vocab_pack.from_passage: go on to register in Cairo University

vocab_pack.definition_en: the field of study covering journalism, broadcasting, and communication technologies
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作 studied 的宾语，为学科名称，固定搭配。
vocab_pack.example_en: She graduated with a degree in media and communications.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她获得了媒体与传播学学位。
vocab_pack.from_passage: studied media and communications

vocab_pack.definition_en: to return something (e.g., money, help) to a community
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中为动词原形，用于不定式 to give back，后接 to society，表示‘回报社会’。
vocab_pack.example_en: Many successful people feel a duty to give back to their communities.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 许多成功人士感到有责任回馈他们的社区。
vocab_pack.from_passage: she did her best to give back to society

vocab_pack.definition_en: to concentrate attention or effort on something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中为名词短语，with a focus on females，介词短语作定语修饰 school，表示‘以女性为重点的学校’。
vocab_pack.example_en: The charity has a focus on children's health.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该慈善机构重点关注儿童健康。
vocab_pack.from_passage: opening a school with a focus on females

vocab_pack.definition_en: of a good enough standard; respectable
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作定语修饰 jobs，decent jobs 表示‘体面的工作’。
vocab_pack.example_en: Everyone deserves a decent wage for their work.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 每个人都应该得到体面的工资。
vocab_pack.from_passage: helping them to find decent jobs in her community

vocab_pack.definition_en: to strongly encourage or advise someone to do something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中为过去时，urged 后接间接宾语 the local community，后接不定式 to acknowledge。
vocab_pack.example_en: The doctor urged him to quit smoking.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 医生敦促他戒烟。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Ruqaia's story urged the local community to acknowledge

vocab_pack.definition_en: to accept or admit the existence or truth of something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中为动词原形，用于不定式 to acknowledge，后接宾语 the importance of education。
vocab_pack.example_en: We must acknowledge the contributions of our predecessors.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们必须承认前辈们的贡献。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to acknowledge the importance of education

vocab_pack.definition_en: the process of setting career goals and determining the steps to achieve them
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 在句中作介词 on 的宾语，与 women's and girls' 构成名词所有格结构，表示‘女性职业规划’。
vocab_pack.example_en: Schools should offer career planning services to students.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 学校应该为学生提供职业规划服务。
vocab_pack.from_passage: importance of education on women's and girls' career planning

section_2_word_form.passage:
Lu Qi, noted as chief scientist of the Chinese Academy of Forestry and director of the Institute of Great Green Wall, [56] to be entitled the Champions of the Earth last month.
Highly praised [57] his contributions to global desertification control, Lu became the first Chinese person to receive the title, [58] achievements have shown through practice that by combining science and policy, humanity can address land degradation issues.
Almost 40 percent of the world's land is already degraded, desertification is on the rise and destructive [59] are becoming more regular. The good news is that solutions already exist today, and across [60] globe, extraordinary individuals and organizations are showing that it is [61] possible to defend and heal the planet.
Lu has led over 50 desertification control-related research projects, [62] China in carrying out the relevant policies and providing expertise to international organizations at the forefront of global desertification action.
Lu's receiving the honor can remind the younger generations as long as they remember their mission and keep innovating, they will definitely gain [63] from society and that the weight of responsibility on their shoulders has increased, and the duty has grown [64].
Lu's team is devoted to sharing the successful experience and models of the ecological projects. There already are cooperation centers and research centers, as well as forums for cooperation, all [65] to spread China's wisdom and experience worldwide.

questions.explanation: 句子的主语是Lu Qi，谓语动词是announce，两者是被动关系（被宣布）；时间状语是last month，故使用一般过去时的被动语态。
questions.supplement: 正确形(was announced): 语境句：The winner of the competition was announced on national television. 固定搭配：be announced to the public, officially announced. 原词announce其它变形：announcement(n. 宣布), announcer(n. 播音员)

questions.explanation: 考查固定搭配。praise sb. for sth. 表示“因某事而赞扬某人”，此处使用其被动形式的过去分词作状语 (being) highly praised for...
questions.supplement: 正确形(for): 语境句：She was widely praised for her brave actions during the fire. 固定搭配：be praised for, be famous for.

questions.explanation: 此处为非限制性定语从句，先行词是the first Chinese person，在从句中作achievements的定语，表示“他的成就”，故填关系代词whose。
questions.supplement: 正确形(whose): 语境句：I have a friend whose father is a famous scientist. 固定搭配：whose name, whose work.

questions.explanation: drought意为“干旱”，是可数名词。根据后面的系动词are可知，主语需用复数形式。
questions.supplement: 正确形(droughts): 语境句：Severe droughts have ruined the crops in the southern region. 固定搭配：severe droughts, prolonged droughts. 原词drought其它变形：drought-stricken(adj. 受旱灾影响的)

questions.explanation: 考查冠词。across the globe是固定表达，意为“在世界各地/全球范围内”，globe前必须加定冠词the。
questions.supplement: 正确形(the): 语境句：People across the globe are working together to combat climate change. 固定搭配：across the globe, around the globe.

questions.explanation: 此处需要一个副词来修饰形容词possible。whole的副词形式是wholly，意为“完全地”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(wholly): 语境句：The new policy was not wholly successful, but it helped somewhat. 固定搭配：wholly possible, wholly responsible. 原词whole其它变形：whole(adj. 整个的), wholeness(n. 完整)

questions.explanation: Lu与assist之间是主动关系，且前面的句子已有谓语动词has led，此处需用现在分词(doing)作伴随状语或结果状语。
questions.supplement: 正确形(assisting): 语境句：The volunteer spent her summer assisting doctors in a rural clinic. 固定搭配：assist sb in doing sth, assist with. 原词assist其它变形：assistance(n. 帮助), assistant(n. 助手)

questions.explanation: gain为及物动词，后需接名词作宾语。recognize的名词形式是recognition，gain recognition意为“获得认可”。
questions.supplement: 正确形(recognition): 语境句：Her research finally gained international recognition after years of hard work. 固定搭配：gain recognition, win recognition. 原词recognize其它变形：recognizable(adj. 可辨认的), unrecognized(adj. 未被承认的)

questions.explanation: 根据前文的has increased（增加了）以及连词and可知，此处表示职责变得“更重了”，需用比较级heavier。
questions.supplement: 正确形(heavier): 语境句：The rain grew heavier as we drove further into the mountains. 固定搭配：grow heavier, much heavier. 原词heavy其它变形：heavily(adv. 沉重地), heaviness(n. 沉重)

questions.explanation: centers and forums与design之间是被动关系，且此处作后置定语，相当于which are designed to...，故用过去分词designed。
questions.supplement: 正确形(designed): 语境句：This program is specially designed to help teenagers build confidence. 固定搭配：be designed to do sth, be designed for. 原词design其它变形：designer(n. 设计师), designation(n. 指定)

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be known or recognized as
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中'noted as'是过去分词短语作定语，修饰Lu Qi，表示被动含义，相当于'who is noted as'。
vocab_pack.example_en: The scientist is noted as a pioneer in renewable energy research.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这位科学家被认为是可再生能源研究的先驱。
vocab_pack.from_passage: noted as chief scientist

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give a title or right to someone
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中'to be entitled'是不定式的被动语态，entitled为过去分词，表示被授予（称号）。
vocab_pack.example_en: The novel entitled her to international fame.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这部小说为她赢得了国际声誉。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to be entitled the Champions of the Earth

vocab_pack.definition_en: to receive a lot of praise
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中'Highly praised'是过去分词短语作状语，省略了be动词，表示被动含义。
vocab_pack.example_en: The project was highly praised for its innovative approach.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该项目因其创新方法受到高度赞扬。
vocab_pack.from_passage: Highly praised for his contributions

vocab_pack.definition_en: the process of land becoming desert
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作主语或宾语，是不可数名词。
vocab_pack.example_en: Desertification threatens the livelihoods of millions of people.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 荒漠化威胁着数百万人的生计。
vocab_pack.from_passage: global desertification control

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be given an official title or award
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中'to receive the title'是不定式短语作定语，修饰'the first Chinese person'，receive为动词原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: She received the title of 'Best Teacher' last year.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她去年获得了“最佳教师”称号。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to receive the title

vocab_pack.definition_en: to deal with or solve a problem
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中'can address'是情态动词后的动词原形，表示能够解决。
vocab_pack.example_en: Governments must address the issue of climate change urgently.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 政府必须紧急处理气候变化问题。
vocab_pack.from_passage: can address land degradation issues

vocab_pack.definition_en: the deterioration of land quality
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作'address'的宾语，是名词短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Soil erosion is a major cause of land degradation.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 土壤侵蚀是土地退化的主要原因。
vocab_pack.from_passage: land degradation issues

vocab_pack.definition_en: increasing or becoming more common
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作表语，与系动词is连用，表示状态。
vocab_pack.example_en: The number of cyber attacks is on the rise globally.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 全球网络攻击的数量正在上升。
vocab_pack.from_passage: desertification is on the rise

vocab_pack.definition_en: causing great damage or harm
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中修饰名词droughts，作定语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The destructive earthquake left thousands homeless.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这场破坏性地震导致数千人无家可归。
vocab_pack.from_passage: destructive droughts

vocab_pack.definition_en: completely possible
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作表语，'it is wholly possible'，其中wholly是程度副词修饰possible。
vocab_pack.example_en: With hard work, success is wholly possible.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 通过努力，成功是完全可能的。
vocab_pack.from_passage: it is wholly possible to defend and heal the planet

vocab_pack.definition_en: to protect from harm or attack
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中与heal并列，在'to defend and heal'中为不定式原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: We must defend the environment for future generations.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 我们必须为子孙后代保护环境。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to defend and heal the planet

vocab_pack.definition_en: to make (something) healthy again
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中与defend并列，在'to defend and heal'中为不定式原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: Time can heal many emotional wounds.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 时间可以治愈许多情感创伤。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to defend and heal the planet

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be in charge of; to guide
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中'has led'是现在完成时，led为过去分词形式。
vocab_pack.example_en: The professor has led several key research projects.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这位教授领导了多个关键研究项目。
vocab_pack.from_passage: has led over 50 desertification control-related research projects

vocab_pack.definition_en: to help with something
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中'assisting in'是现在分词短语，作伴随状语，assist后接in加动名词。
vocab_pack.example_en: The assistant is assisting in organizing the conference.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这位助手正在协助组织会议。
vocab_pack.from_passage: assisting China in carrying out the relevant policies

vocab_pack.definition_en: to perform or complete a task
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中'carrying out'是动名词形式，作介词in的宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The team will carry out the experiment next week.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该团队将在下周进行实验。
vocab_pack.from_passage: carrying out the relevant policies

vocab_pack.definition_en: to give expert knowledge or skills to
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中'providing expertise to'是现在分词短语，与前面的assisting并列，表示伴随。
vocab_pack.example_en: The organization provides expertise to developing countries.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该组织向发展中国家提供专业知识。
vocab_pack.from_passage: providing expertise to international organizations

vocab_pack.definition_en: in the leading position in a particular field
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作定语修饰'organizations'，介词短语。
vocab_pack.example_en: This university is at the forefront of artificial intelligence research.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这所大学处于人工智能研究的最前沿。
vocab_pack.from_passage: at the forefront of global desertification action

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause someone to remember
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中'can remind'是情态动词后的动词原形，后接that从句。
vocab_pack.example_en: The photo reminds me of my childhood.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这张照片让我想起我的童年。
vocab_pack.from_passage: can remind the younger generations

vocab_pack.definition_en: provided that; on condition that
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 只要（引导条件状语从句）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中连接条件状语从句，从句用一般现在时表示将来。
vocab_pack.example_en: You can succeed as long as you never give up.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 只要你不放弃，就能成功。
vocab_pack.from_passage: as long as they remember their mission

vocab_pack.definition_en: to continue to create new ideas or methods
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中'keep innovating'是动词keep后接动名词，表示持续做某事。
vocab_pack.example_en: Companies must keep innovating to stay competitive.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 公司必须不断创新以保持竞争力。
vocab_pack.from_passage: keep innovating

vocab_pack.definition_en: to receive approval or acknowledgment
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中'will gain recognition'是一般将来时，gain为动词原形。
vocab_pack.example_en: Her hard work finally gained recognition from the public.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她的努力终于获得了公众的认可。
vocab_pack.from_passage: gain recognition from society

vocab_pack.definition_en: the burden or importance of duty
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作从句主语，是名词短语，'the weight of responsibility'。
vocab_pack.example_en: The weight of responsibility rested on his shoulders.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 责任的重担压在他的肩上。
vocab_pack.from_passage: the weight of responsibility on their shoulders

vocab_pack.definition_en: as one's responsibility or burden
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中作定语修饰'responsibility'，介词短语，their对应younger generations。
vocab_pack.example_en: The success of the project rests on your shoulders.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 项目的成功取决于你。
vocab_pack.from_passage: on their shoulders

vocab_pack.definition_en: to become heavier (often figuratively)
vocab_pack.definition_zh: 变得更重（常比喻责任等）
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中'has grown heavier'是现在完成时，grow为系动词，后跟比较级形容词。
vocab_pack.example_en: The burden of debt grows heavier each month.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 债务负担每个月都在加重。
vocab_pack.from_passage: has grown heavier

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be dedicated to an activity
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中'is devoted to sharing'中be动词用is，主语为单数，devoted是过去分词作表语，to是介词后接动名词。
vocab_pack.example_en: The foundation is devoted to promoting education.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该基金会致力于促进教育。
vocab_pack.from_passage: is devoted to sharing the successful experience

vocab_pack.definition_en: to tell others about one's own experiences
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中'sharing'是动名词，作介词to的宾语，后接宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: They often share their experience with young entrepreneurs.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 他们经常与年轻企业家分享经验。
vocab_pack.from_passage: sharing the successful experience

vocab_pack.definition_en: in addition to; and also
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中连接名词短语，表示并列，重点在前。
vocab_pack.example_en: The program offers financial support as well as technical advice.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 该项目提供资金支持以及技术咨询。
vocab_pack.from_passage: as well as forums for cooperation

vocab_pack.definition_en: to be intended for a specific purpose
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中'designed to spread'是过去分词短语作定语，修饰'centers'等，相当于'which are designed'。
vocab_pack.example_en: The new policy is designed to reduce carbon emissions.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这项新政策旨在减少碳排放。
vocab_pack.from_passage: designed to spread China's wisdom

vocab_pack.definition_en: to share knowledge and insight widely
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中'to spread'是不定式，后接'China's wisdom'作宾语。
vocab_pack.example_en: The teacher aims to spread wisdom to her students.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 这位老师旨在向学生传播智慧。
vocab_pack.from_passage: to spread China's wisdom

vocab_pack.definition_en: relating to the environment and ecosystems
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中修饰名词projects，作定语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Ecological balance is vital for human survival.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 生态平衡对人类生存至关重要。
vocab_pack.from_passage: ecological projects

vocab_pack.definition_en: to cause to become worse in quality
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中'is already degraded'是被动语态的现在时，degraded为过去分词作表语。
vocab_pack.example_en: Continuous farming can degrade the soil over time.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 持续耕作会逐渐使土壤退化。
vocab_pack.from_passage: land is already degraded

vocab_pack.definition_en: very unusual or remarkable
vocab_pack.grammar_note: 原文中修饰名词individuals，作定语。
vocab_pack.example_en: She made extraordinary progress in just one year.
vocab_pack.example_zh: 她在短短一年内取得了非凡的进步。
vocab_pack.from_passage: extraordinary individuals
